text: Mina held a moon atlas, and she wanted to sketch the moon. Jun said, “My whale book is missing.” Mina said, “I promise to help you.” Mina and Jun searched the window nook, but Mina did not locate the whale book. Jun saw the star bookmark on the high shelf. Ms Alvarez reserved the moon atlas for Mina. Using the ladder, Ms Alvarez lifted the whale book down. Ms Alvarez handed the whale book to Jun. Jun told Mina, “I could help you.” Jun opened the moon atlas for Mina. Mina drew the moon from the moon atlas on the paper. Mina showed Jun the moon drawing.
